name: si
description: Smithsonian Institution (si.edu) site search. No commands could be built: every recorded request hit a bot-verification wall, so no usable endpoint was captured.
notes: The only recorded request (E1, GET https://www.si.edu/search) returned a 307 redirect to a 'Request verification / Just a moment...' bot challenge, not search results. No response body, HTML outline or JSON was captured, so there are no selectors or fields to build a replayable command from.
https://www.si.edu/collections hit the same bot challenge. collections.si.edu/search/results.htm is disallowed by robots.txt and was not explored.
No search, listing, detail, filter or pagination endpoint was observed, so writing commands would mean inventing URLs and selectors that the verifier could not confirm.

Possible alternative, not seen in this recording: the Smithsonian publishes a documented Open Access API at https://api.si.edu/openaccess/api/v1.0/ (for example /search?q=...&api_key=...). It needs a free api.data.gov key. To support this site, re-explore against that API with a key and build commands from the recorded JSON responses.

A second pass with a browser session that clears the challenge could also capture the www.si.edu/search results page. Its HTML structure would then need to be recorded before any extract selectors can be written.
